# sevalla_api_key_roles (Data Source)

Use this data source to list all available Sevalla API key roles.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) The list of available API key roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of what this role allows.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the role.
- `name` (String) The name of the role.
- `permissions` (List of String) List of permission IDs granted by this role.
